items.reason: Owner-reviewed: the Savannah Mall directory and the Crazy Store chain site confirm this branch's shop number and basic hours, but neither source describes this store's actual product range or anything branch-specific beyond the shop listing. Remains deferred until a source gives real Savannah Mall branch content; nothing generic is being written from the shop number and category alone.

Held until the shop number is reconciled against the live listing data; publishing now risks stating the wrong shop number.

Current accommodation-platform listings (Booking.com, Hotels.com) describe this property as a single apartment unit -- one bedroom, one bathroom, a kitchen, a terrace/garden and free Wi-Fi -- which does not support the existing '20-room motel and spa' description. Held pending a source that actually confirms room count and spa services; writing from the apartment listing alone would contradict the current description without resolving which is accurate.
